name: io.github.kraken222/sovereign-observer-mcp
description: Scan Terraform for security misconfigurations while your AI assistant writes it. Runs locally; your code is never uploaded.

environmentVariables.name: SOVEREIGN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. An organization token from the Sovereign Observer dashboard (Integrations → GitHub). With it set, the server also enforces your company's own Terraform rules. Rules are downloaded; your code is never uploaded.

environmentVariables.name: SOVEREIGN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the API base URL when self-hosting Sovereign Observer.
